Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class ManagerDashboardController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.ManagerDashboardController
public class ManagerDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Manager Dashboard in the Cafe94 system.

This dashboard enables the manager to:

  • View, add, edit, and remove staff profiles
  • Monitor outstanding orders and view order details
  • Generate various business reports (e.g., top staff, popular items)
The manager dashboard integrates with shared utilities like ReportHelper, OutstandingOrderHelper, and DataSaver for managing data display and persistence.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(OrderManaged orderManaged)
      Initializes the Manager Dashboard with order and staff data.

      Loads the staff list and outstanding orders into their respective tables, and displays the name of the currently logged-in staff member.

      Parameters:
      orderManaged - The order manager instance containing all current orders.

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the Manager Dashboard UI components.

      Configures table columns, binds the remove button, and sets up order and item table views using helper utilities.

    • handleLogout

      private void handleLogout()
      Logs the manager out of the dashboard and returns to the login screen.

    • handleAddStaff

      private void handleAddStaff()
      Handles the action of adding a new staff member.

      Opens a popup form for entering new staff details. If the user confirms and saves the new staff, it is added to the table, synchronized with the application state, and persisted to file.

    • handleEditStaff

      private void handleEditStaff()
      Handles the editing of a selected staff member.

      Opens a pre-filled popup for editing the selected staff's details. On confirmation, the changes are saved, the table is refreshed, and data is persisted to file.

    • handleRemoveStaff

      private void handleRemoveStaff()
      Handles the removal of a selected staff member.

      Prompts for confirmation before deleting the selected staff member from the table, application state, and file. Displays a confirmation message upon successful removal.

    • syncStaffListToAppState

      private void syncStaffListToAppState()
      Synchronizes the current staff list with the global AppState.

      This ensures that any changes made locally (e.g., add/edit/remove) are reflected across the application.
